_comment: The lab's physical limits, as data. These are the things that stop a
visit happening no matter how well anyone scores: there is no third tech
kit, the university is shut, nobody is trained to drive the van.
Everything here is editable by hand and takes effect on the next start.
WHAT IS TRANSCRIBED FROM THE MANUAL:
tech_kits.NANO = 2      'No more than 2 NANO visits can happen at one
time - we only have 2 NANO tech kits.'
closed_weekdays = [4]   'Fridays are designated lab meeting days. No
visits should be scheduled on Fridays.'
working_hours           'anything scheduled to go beyond 30 minutes
outside of 9am-5pm on Monday-Friday' is an
out-of-hours visit.
vehicles                the Assigning a Vehicle section.
WHAT THE LAB STILL HAS TO FILL IN:
holidays                'On designated USC staff holidays, no visits
should be scheduled (no exceptions to this).'
The manual does not list the dates, so this
ships empty. An empty list means the board does
not know the holidays rather than that there are
none, and it says so on screen rather than
quietly scheduling through them.

vehicles.name: van
vehicles.note: At least one staff member must be van-approved, ideally both. Where two visits run at once the shorter drive takes the van, and a visit with two van-trained staff takes it outright.

vehicles.name: rental
vehicles.note: No training or approval needed. Where two visits run at once the longer drive takes the rental.

_comment: Whether a calendar read off a screenshot counts immediately, or waits
for somebody to confirm it.
true  (the current setting): a screenshot applies the moment it is
uploaded, exactly like a PDF. No confirmation step.
false: blocks read off pixels are held until a human settles them in
the 'To confirm' tab, and until then they are neither free nor
busy.
WHAT THE SETTING COSTS. A PDF is vector extraction: the times are read
from the file and are exact. A screenshot is measured off pixels, and
the reader can miss a block at the edge of a grid or misread an hour
by one row. With auto-commit on, a block it failed to see is simply
absent, and absent time reads as free. The board will offer a slot
somebody is actually busy in.
The evidence tier still records that it was a screenshot, so the
provenance is never lost even when the review step is skipped.
Upload a PDF print where the timing matters.
